profile.name: Gunvir Singh
profile.headline: B.Tech CSAI Undergraduate at NSUT | Seeking Software Engineering Internships
profile.summary: I am a B.Tech student in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), interested in software engineering, problem-solving, and AI-enabled applications. I work with Python and Flask and am developing my foundations in data structures and algorithms, databases, operating systems, computer architecture, and mathematics. Through hands-on projects and competitive programming, I aim to build useful, reliable software and strengthen my engineering skills. I am currently seeking software engineering internships.
